selection_policy: one selection per race from the top-ranked runner(s)
model_probability: validation-temperature-calibrated within-race probability with Plackett-Luce/Harville extension
proxy_warning: q-derived Harville probabilities are not actual combination-pool market probabilities
combination_market_probability_limit: actual ROI is identifiable, but actual combination-market EDGE remains unavailable because only winning dividends are published in the joined file

top3_definitions.ordered: predicted first/second/third exactly match actual first/second/third
top3_definitions.unordered: set of predicted top three equals set of actual top three
